title: Duplicate email rejected on INSERT
sql: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash) VALUES ('dup.user', 'qa@taskflow.io', '$2y$10$abc123');

title: Email lookup uses idx_email
sql: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'qa@taskflow.io';
expected_result: plan shows Index Scan on idx_email not Seq Scan
expected_sql_outcome: Index Scan using idx_email on users

title: Failed INSERT inside a transaction leaves no residue
test_data: two INSERTs where the second violates NOT NULL
sql: BEGIN; INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash) VALUES ('tx.one','one@taskflow.io','h'); INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash) VALUES ('tx.two', NULL, 'h'); ROLLBACK; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE username LIKE 'tx.%';
expected_result: count returns 0; both statements rolled back
